steps.text: You need three goblin mails, which you can find around the Goblin Village. The first is up the ladder in a crate in the south of the village.
Search the crate up the ladder.
Search the crate in the west of Goblin Village for Goblin Mail.
The second goblin mail can be found in the west hut in a crate.
Search the crate north of the General's hut in Goblin Village.
The last goblin mail is north of the generals' hut in a crate.
Use the blue dye on one of the goblin mail.
Use the orange dye on one of the goblin mail.
Talk to one of the Goblin Generals in Goblin Village.
choices: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?
So how is life for the goblins?
I have some orange armour here.

steps.text: Talk to one of the Goblin Generals in Goblin Village again.
choices: So how is life for the goblins?
I have some blue armour here.

steps.text: Talk to one of the Goblin Generals in Goblin Village once more.
choices: So how is life for the goblins?
I have some brown armour here.
